data: Does the loss of the 'No regularizer' model converge to a lower value than the loss of the 'No LNS' model?

The caption provides information about the regularizer, which is the cosine multiplier in the equation (11). The question asks whether the loss of the 'No regularizer' model converges to a lower value than the loss of the 'No LNS' model. From the analysis of the figure, the 'No regularizer' model is represented by the green line, and the 'No LNS' model is represented by the blue line. Observing the convergence curves, the 'No regularizer' model (green line) appears to converge to a higher value compared to the 'No LNS' model (blue line). Therefore, the loss of the 'No regularizer' model does not converge to a lower value than the loss of the 'No LNS' model.
